text:
incident-bot: ALERT detected: inference-serving > p95 latency 450ms for 3m (alert_key=inference-latency-p95, source=prod-us-east)
jen (oncall): seeing it, paging went out. I'm on it. beginning triage now.
mike (sre): thx. initial hypothesis: KV cache churn on latest model rollout? diane can you confirm if rollout happened ~2m before?
diane (eng-runtime): rolling deploy started at 1748882000, finished at 1748882150. no errors in deploy job but we saw increased cache evictions around 1748882105.
jen (oncall): customer impact? any 5xxs or request failures reported?
sam (observability): customer-facing errors steady. increased client latency only. top affected service: /v1/generate (80% of traces). Adding a quick dashboard panel -> https://grafana/redwood/d/abc123/inference
mike (sre): ok this looks like a performance degradation, not an availability incident. can we avoid loud PD paging for this class? current rule pages for >3m p95>400ms which is too aggressive for brief rollout blips.
jen (oncall): agree. can we route to a lower urgency and create a short-term aggregation to prevent multiple PD incidents from the same root?
mike (sre): propose: change rule to only page if sustained for 15m OR correlated with error rate >0.5% OR if p99>600ms. Also create a correlation fingerprint on model version and cluster.
diane (eng-runtime): we can add a tagging field model_version and node_pool and use it for grouping. will push a small change to the metric labels in the runtime by EOD.
ops-runbook-bot: Recommended playbooks: "performance-degradation-lite" and "temp-throttle-kv-repair". See runbook links.
jen (oncall): immediate mitigation: apply transient routing to send alerts to #eng-oncall-info (no PD) for 30m while we confirm root cause. I'll create a short-lived alert override.
mike (sre): command to create override (ops tool): `ops-alerts override create --rule inference-latency-p95 --suppress-pd --duration 30m --owner jen`
mike (sre): doing it now.
jen (oncall): override applied. PD will not page for this alert for 30m; slack notifications still in channel.
sam (observability): while suppressed, I'll spin up a filtered dashboard showing per-model p95 and eviction rate and a histogram of sequence lengths. will also add a small traffic-split view.
diane (eng-runtime): quick fix: increase local KV cache size on canary nodes, rolling restart them with new env `KV_CACHE_SIZE=1.4GB` for 10% of fleet to test effect.
jen (oncall): please coordinate so we don't create churn. Do it on 10% canary first.
diane (eng-runtime): ack, starting canary restart now.
mike (sre): post-incident tuning notes we should capture: 1) change alert to 15m OR p99>600ms OR errors. 2) add metadata labels (model_version, node_pool) for grouping. 3) create an "alert-priority" label to route minor perf regressions to info channel only. 4) implement rate window backoff to avoid per-minute flurries.
jen (oncall): logging note: we got a flood of near-duplicate slack alerts because each node emitted separate rule hits. sam, can we add a deduping step in the notifier that clusters by fingerprint (model_version + hint) within 60s and collapse to one message?
sam (observability): yes. I'll add a dedupe window of 60s and a cluster-by list. Also will add a "suppressed_count" field so details show how many were collapsed.
ops-runbook-bot: Action assigned: sam -> implement dedupe; mike -> update PD rule condition; diane -> add model labels; jen -> perform 30m override and coordinate canary. ETA for all changes: 2h for mitigations, 24h for full rule rollout.
jen (oncall): customer comms: no user-facing errors, only latency increase. I'll update #support with a short note and mark impact as "degraded performance".
mike (sre): follow-up tasks for postmortem: - refine alert thresholds; - build a compact dashboard summarizing bursty alerts; - runbook section: when to suppress vs page; - add automated fallback to older model variant when p95 spikes above 800ms.
diane (eng-runtime): note: rollouts should add a gradual cache-warm step in default pipeline. I'll file a PR with a staged warm-up for next deployment.
jen (oncall): last check: can we lift the override earlier if canary looks good?
mike (sre): yes, we can abort override. monitor canary for 20m then decide.
diane (eng-runtime): canary results: p95 back down to baseline after cache bump. no errors. proceeding to roll forward config to 30%.
sam (observability): lifting override now. `ops-alerts override delete --id 9876` done.
jen (oncall): override removed, PD will resume normal behavior.
mike (sre): closing handoff: we've reduced noise risk by changing page conditions and adding dedupe and grouping by labels. we'll follow up with a short incident note and action items.
jen (oncall): thanks team. I'll post a brief post-incident summary and owners to #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
ops-runbook-bot: Incident recap created: https://wiki/redwood/incidents/1748882222-inference-latency-prio-routing"
